applicationProfileUsageNote.en: A broader concept than citizenship is limited to the relationship with a state and associated rights and obligations. Anyone who holds the nationality of a particular country is usually automatically a citizen of it. It is usually acquired automatically by birth: one either receives the nationality of one's parents or one obtains it of the country of which one is a resident.
